goal: Improve one end-to-end Margins user job using research-informed Playwright/video evidence and a real LLM distillation run over stable capture fixtures.

when.fires: manual during UX work; on PRs touching desktop UI/distill surfaces; optionally nightly against long fixtures

pick_work: Choose one user job and one fixture. Prefer jobs affected by the diff. Do not run broad rewrites or multiple unrelated UX fixes in one pass.

vault_context_pass.when: Run unless the task is a narrow mechanical bug, pure CSS regression, or harness failure where product context cannot change the fix.
queries: User language around the job, artifact, workflow, and concern.
Adjacent product memories: prior UX reviews, naming decisions, user complaints, sample notes, or desired Margins feel.
Fixture/domain anchors from memo.md, aligned.md, and capture-context.md.
vault_context_pass.limit: Keep 3-7 high-signal notes or catalysts. Record breadcrumbs, not note dumps.
output: Source breadcrumbs with one sentence of relevance.
Terms the product should prefer or avoid.
Trust signals the UI or generated note should make visible.
One or more falsifiable claims derived from vault context.

research.output: A short job-specific UX brief: mindset, path, expected information hierarchy, copy rules, clutter risks, latency expectations, and falsifiable claims.

journey_plan.input: research brief + current app/source + available fixtures
journey_plan.output: A dynamic Playwright journey: starting state, user actions, typed text, expected transitions, observation points, timing marks, and stop/escalation criteria.

act.browser: Headless Chrome/Vite on VPS with mocked permissions and native shell behavior.

runtime_vault.setup: Create a run-scoped Obsidian-shaped vault and runtime JSON before opening the browser harness.
runtime_vault.cleanup: Remove the runtime JSON and runtime-vault directory after the Playwright run; keep evidence artifacts.

playwright_video.runner: Use the Playwright CLI or test runner once wired, with video recording enabled for the full journey.
artifacts: journey.webm or the raw Playwright video
requirements: Record from journey start through completion or failure.
Keep the raw video even when MP4 conversion fails.
Use stable artifact names for judge/verifier threads.
Record the video conversion command in the run manifest.

act.llm: Run real Pi/LLM distillation against fixture memo/transcript/capture context for selected E2E jobs.

durable_spine: Capture stable artifacts from a journey: screenshots, visible text, timing, generated note, trace, video, and manifest.
Run a judge pass that scores those artifacts against the job brief, expected-user-job.md, and falsifiable claims.
Emit judge-verdict.json with claim IDs, deterministic checks, evidence paths, note_source, and overall pass/risk/fail.
per_job_skin: Fixture, runtime vault seed notes, journey intent, typed refinement, and falsifiable claims.
Allowed to churn with product direction; adding a job should not fork the durable judge.
runner_hooks: Prefer role/state/test-id hooks over exact copy assertions so the judge can critique wording without breaking the runner.
Use literal copy only when the job explicitly makes that wording a requirement.

checks.description: No console/runtime errors during the journey.
The user receives visible feedback quickly after each major action.
First visible note text appears before the wait feels opaque.
Visible text and generated notes avoid implementation/private language such as synthesize, semantic search, raw tool names, channel labels, and absolute temp paths.
UI or generated note makes the seeded vault/domain context visible without exposing developer plumbing.
Provenance/how-generated details are inspectable but secondary to the note.
The generated note satisfies expected-user-job.md for the selected fixture.
Refinement continues the same note context and updates the visible artifact.

when: The issue is product/taste judgment without an artifact-backed judge finding.
Generated note quality is the bottleneck rather than the interface.
The LLM/provider is unavailable or too slow to judge the app fairly.
Two patch attempts do not improve the same falsifiable claim ID in judge-verdict.json.
hand_off.to: A concise UX review with video/timing evidence and the smallest proposed product decision.

done.success: The rerun shows a concrete improvement for the selected user job and all artifacts are recorded.
done.give_up: The loop reaches a human judgment boundary, provider failure, or patch budget without improvement.
